description: Segment file names. pattern is the leaf Get-CamSegmentPattern builds; samples are the names ffmpeg writes for those local times and offsets (substituted here, ffmpeg not run); accept/reject are what Test-CamSegmentName answers for the configured container. A trap row records an observed oddity.

samples.name: Camera_One_20261025_033000+0300.mkv
samples.note: first pass through 03:30 on the fall-back day (summer time)

samples.name: Camera_One_20261025_033000+0200.mkv
samples.note: second pass through the same wall time after the fall-back: only the offset tells them apart

samples.name: Camera_One_20270328_040000+0300.mkv
samples.note: first segment after the spring-forward (03:00 does not exist)

samples.name: Camera_One_20260105_235959+0200.mkv
samples.note: winter, end of day

samples.name: Camera_One_20260701_000000+0300.mkv
samples.note: summer, start of day

samples.name: Camera_One_20260701_120000+0530.mkv
samples.note: a non-hour offset (not this zone; the pattern must still hold)

samples.name: Camera_One_20260701_120000-0330.mkv
samples.note: a negative non-hour offset
